proof.rationale: The updated skill now requires two independent signals (e.g., exact unique match plus consistent remittance or a matching reference, or very few open items) before auto-applying, and explicitly holds receipts that reference already-paid invoices or lack any confirming signal. This prevents misapplication on ambiguous wires while safely taking over cases where the payer's instructions clearly resolve multiple matching subsets.
